== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V) (Errata)]] shares the [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V)]] column; [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V) (Errata 2)]] shares the [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V)]] column.
